title: Kashmir
tagline: Pristine Himalayan valleys, floating shikara sanctuaries, and snow-draped pine ridges.
description: Experience paradise on earth. Glide silently across Dal Lake in hand-carved cedar shikaras, explore the snowfields of Gulmarg, wander through saffron meadows in Pampore, and unwind beside roaring fireplaces in luxury walnut-wood cedar houseboats.
highlights: Private hand-carved cedarwood luxury houseboat stay on serene Dal Lake
Sunset shikara ride across floating lotus gardens and water bazaars
Gulmarg Gondola cable car ascent to Apharwat Peak at 4,200m
Private culinary wazwan dining experience with master chefs in Srinagar

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara
itinerary.description: Private airport transfer to your luxury heritage houseboat, followed by evening chai on Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens & Old City Crafts
itinerary.description: Explore Nishat and Shalimar gardens and private craft workshops of Pashmina and papier-mâché.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam & Betaab Valley
itinerary.description: Drive along saffron fields to Pahalgam; riverside walks along the Lidder river.

itinerary.title: Aru Valley & Alpine Glades
itinerary.description: Pony treks through pristine pine forests and glacial streams in Aru.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg High Altitude Meadows
itinerary.description: Transfer to Gulmarg; check in to an alpine luxury resort with panoramic Himalayan views.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Gondola & Apharwat Peak
itinerary.description: Ride the world's second-highest cable car to powdery snowfields and ski trails.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Departure
itinerary.description: Farewell Kashmiri kahwa and private chauffeur transfer to Srinagar Airport.

included: Heritage luxury houseboat and 5-star mountain resort stays
Private chauffeurs and dedicated local expert docents
All meals including traditional multicourse Wazwan dinners

title: Delhi
tagline: Timeless Mughal grandeur, tree-lined colonial boulevards, and vibrant heritage bazaars.
description: Immerse yourself in India's historic capital. Discover centuries of architectural wonder from the imposing Red Fort and Humayun's Tomb to the tranquil Lotus Temple and lush Lodi Gardens, paired with private culinary expeditions through Chandni Chowk.
highlights: Private architectural docent walk through Humayun's Tomb & Qutub Minar
Exclusive cycle rickshaw spice and food safari in Chandni Chowk
Stays at iconic luxury heritage hotels like The Imperial
Private shopping access to master textile weavers and jewelers

itinerary.title: Arrival in New Delhi
itinerary.description: Private airport chauffeur transfer to your heritage suite; evening high tea.

itinerary.title: Old Delhi & Mughal Landmarks
itinerary.description: Private guided tour of Jama Masjid, Red Fort, and rickshaw spice trail.

itinerary.title: Humayun's Tomb & Sunder Nursery
itinerary.description: Discover the precursor to the Taj Mahal and restored Persian gardens.

itinerary.title: Lutyens' Delhi & Modern Art
itinerary.description: Drive down Rashtrapati Bhavan, India Gate, and the National Gallery of Modern Art.

itinerary.title: Qutub Minar & Mehrauli Heritage Park
itinerary.description: Explore 12th-century victory towers and ancient Sufi shrines.

itinerary.title: Culinary & Textile Safari
itinerary.description: Exclusive tasting menu with celebrity chefs and private boutique atelier visits.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Private chauffeur transfer to Indira Gandhi International Airport.

included: Private air-conditioned luxury sedan & personal chauffeur
Curated private heritage docents & all entry tickets
Daily gourmet breakfasts and curated specialty dinners

title: Mumbai
tagline: Arabian Sea sunsets, colonial heritage architecture, and vibrant coastal culture.
description: Immerse yourself in the City of Dreams with unparalleled luxury. Sail on a private catamaran as the sun sets over the Arabian Sea, explore the grand Victorian Gothic and Art Deco heritage of South Mumbai with a private architectural historian, and enjoy table reservations at award-winning oceanfront dining rooms.
highlights: Private yacht charter at sunset past the iconic Gateway of India
Curated heritage walk through Kala Ghoda and the UNESCO Victorian & Art Deco precinct
Exclusive access and private table at iconic oceanfront heritage dining spots
Private modern art gallery and boutique fashion studio tour in Bandra

itinerary.title: Arrival & Gateway Sunset Sail
itinerary.description: Private airport transfer to a luxury sea-facing hotel; late afternoon private yacht cruise on the Arabian Sea.

itinerary.title: Victorian Gothic & Art Deco Heritage
itinerary.description: Private docent walking tour through CST, Oval Maidan, and the heritage lanes of Fort.

itinerary.title: Art, Culinary & Bandra Lanes
itinerary.description: Explore Kala Ghoda art galleries followed by a coastal drive over the Bandra-Worli Sea Link to heritage Portuguese bungalows.

itinerary.title: Elephanta Caves & Harbour Cruise
itinerary.description: Private speedboat to UNESCO rock-cut cave temples on Elephanta Island.

itinerary.title: Coastal Gastronomy & Seaside Cocktails
itinerary.description: Curated seafood culinary tasting with master local chefs and rooftop sunset.

itinerary.title: Marine Drive Promenade & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast overlooking the Queen's Necklace; luxury airport chauffeur transfer.

included: Private luxury chauffeur transfers in premium sedans
Private catamaran yacht charter on the Arabian Sea
Private architectural and cultural docent guides

title: Meghalaya
tagline: The abode of clouds, sacred rainforests, and centuries-old living root bridges.
description: Venture deep into the sacred rainforests of the Khasi Hills. Walk across bio-engineered living root bridges grown over centuries, swim in the glass-clear waters of the Umngot River in Dawki, and witness thunderous waterfalls plunging into mist-filled gorges in Cherrapunji.
highlights: Trek to the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge in Nongriat
Boat over crystal-clear floating reflections on the Umngot River in Dawki
Watch the majestic Nohkalikai and Seven Sisters waterfalls plunge through cloud gorges
Explore the sacred groves of Mawphlang with indigenous Khasi wisdom keepers

itinerary.title: Guwahati to Shillong
itinerary.description: Scenic hill drive past Umiam Lake to the colonial hill station of Shillong.

itinerary.title: Mawphlang Sacred Forest & Khasi Heritage
itinerary.description: Guided walk inside centuries-old pristine sacred rainforests.

itinerary.title: Cherrapunji & Nohkalikai Falls
itinerary.description: Dramatic journey to Cherrapunji; stand atop cliffside viewing platforms above the clouds.

itinerary.title: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Expedition
itinerary.description: Descend ancient stone stairways through lush jungle to witness living architectural wonders.

itinerary.title: Dawki Crystal Waters & Shnongpdeng
itinerary.description: Glide across the emerald glass waters of Dawki near the Indo-Bangladesh border.

itinerary.title: Return via Guwahati
itinerary.description: Scenic morning drive back to Guwahati for flight departure.

included: Private 4x4 vehicles and specialized hiking guides
All entry permits, village conservation passes, and boat charters
Authentic Khasi gastronomic lunches and daily organic breakfasts

title: Maldives
tagline: Ultra-luxury overwater villas, bioluminescent lagoons, and pristine coral atolls.
description: Escape to an intimate sanctuary of overwater villas perched above shimmering turquoise lagoons. Cruise on private catamarans across crystal atolls, snorkel alongside manta rays, and enjoy sunset dining on secluded sandbanks.
highlights: Overwater pool villa on an exclusive private atoll
Round-trip seaplane flight with panoramic aerial views
Private sunset sandbank dinner with private sommelier
Night snorkel with bioluminescent plankton and manta rays

itinerary.title: Arrival in Malé & Seaplane Flight
itinerary.description: Scenic flight over sapphire coral rings directly to your resort's overwater arrival jetty.

itinerary.title: Overwater Living & Lagoon Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Direct ocean ladder access to protected house reefs filled with sea turtles.

itinerary.title: Private Sandbank Picnic & Spa
itinerary.description: Midday boat transfer to an uninhabited sandbar followed by holistic spa treatments.

itinerary.title: Catamaran Sunset Cruise & Dolphin Watching
itinerary.description: Champagne cruise watching spinner dolphins play in the golden hour wake.

itinerary.title: Bioluminescent Night Dive
itinerary.description: Guided evening snorkeling under illuminated starry skies.

itinerary.title: Seaplane Transfer to Malé & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning villa breakfast before aerial seaplane transfer to Malé International Airport.

title: Rajasthan
tagline: Royal palaces of Maharajas, golden desert dunes, and timeless Mewar heritage.
description: Experience the majestic land of kings. Stay in opulent royal palaces, witness the sunset over the golden sand dunes of Thar, explore the pink sandstone facades of Jaipur and the romantic lake palaces of Udaipur with private royal historians.
highlights: Stay inside historic converted royal palaces
Private sunrise access to Amber Fort & City Palace
Camel safari & luxury tented glamping in Sam Sand Dunes
Private Mewari royal dining experience with classical musicians

itinerary.title: Arrival in Pink City Jaipur
itinerary.description: Private airport chauffeur transfer to a royal heritage palace; evening stroll through Johari Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort & Hawa Mahal
itinerary.description: Morning ascent to Amber Fort with private royal historian; photo stop at the Palace of Winds.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Blue City & Mehrangarh Fort
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Jodhpur; explore the towering cliffside fortress and Jaswant Thada.

itinerary.title: Thar Desert Sunset & Royal Camp
itinerary.description: Private camel safari through desert dunes; night under desert stars with folk music.

itinerary.title: Royal Farewell & Departure
itinerary.description: Palace brunch and private chauffeur transfer to Jaipur Airport.

included: Private luxury chauffeur in air-conditioned SUV
All monument entry passes & cultural events
